sloka: एता वाचो मनुष्याणाम् ग्राम सम्वास वासिनाम् ।शृण्वन्न् अति ययौ वीरः कोसलान् कोसल ईश्वरः ॥२-४९-९॥
transliteration: etā vāco manuṣyāṇām grāma samvāsa vāsinām ।śṛṇvann ati yayau vīraḥ kosalān kosala īśvaraḥ ॥2-49-9॥

translations.english: Such were the words of people living in villages and hamlets that Rama the valiant lord of Kosala happened to hear as he was crossing the boundaries of Kosala.
